main_measure.name: mean 20-bar forward excess return over coin mean, active bars, non-overlapping
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; at least 30 non-overlapping active blocks

supporting_check.name: slope of 20-bar excess return on forecast level (non-overlapping active blocks)

decided_by: The t-statistic lies between -2 and 2, meeting the plan's inconclusive rule.
reading: The coin's mean 20-bar return is taken over every bar of all its windows (overlapping, within windows); the active blocks are the active bars (forecast > 0) on the grid 0, 20, 40, ... of each window; the situation is checked on the raw slow/medium returns, using the regime label where they are missing.
